query.value:
SELECT
    firstname                   AS firstname,
    lastname                    AS lastname,
    userid                      AS cog_userid,
    last_login                  AS cog_lastlogin,
    updated_at                  AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                  AS overriddencreatedon

FROM growecd.app_users
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE()

SELECT
    mobilenumber                AS mobilephone,
    email                       AS emailaddress1,
    firstname                   AS firstname,
    lastname                    AS lastname,
    birthdate                   AS birthdate,
    gender                      AS cog_gendercode,
    race                        AS cog_racecode,
    race_text                   AS cog_raceother,
    city                        AS address1_city,
    physical_address            AS address1_line1,
    countrycode                 AS cog_countryid,
    regioncode                  AS cog_region,
    profileid                   AS cog_giraffeprofileid,
    centreid                    AS cog_centreid,
    usertype                    AS cog_rolecode,
    start_date                  AS cog_startdate,
    child_protection            AS cog_childprotectionclearancecode,
    employment_type             AS cog_employmenttypecode,
    qualification               AS cog_highestqualificationcode,
    work_hours_total            AS cog_workhourstotal,
    updated_at                 AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                 AS overriddencreatedon,
    userid                     AS cog_applicationuser   

FROM growecd.centre_profiles
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE()

SELECT
    centreid AS cog_centreid,
    name                       AS name,
    city                       AS address1_city,
    physical_address           AS address1_line1,
    email                      AS emailaddress1,
    phone_number               AS telephone1,
    start_date                 AS cog_centrestartdate,
    capacity                   AS cog_learnercapacity,
    classrooms                 AS cog_classroomcount,
    ecd_type                   AS cog_ecdtypecode,
    agreement_type             AS cog_agreementtypecode,
    updated_at                 AS cog_giraffeupdatedon,
    created_at                 AS overriddencreatedon,
    grow_programme             AS cog_programme,   
    programme_status           AS cog_programmestatuscode,
    countrycode                AS cog_countryid,
    regioncode                 AS cog_region,
    property_type              AS cog_propertytypecode,
    centre_type                AS cog_centretypecode,
    class_types                AS cog_classtypecode,
    operating_hours            AS cog_operatinghours
FROM growecd.centres
WHERE updated_at >= '@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkDate}'
  AND updated_at < CURDATE()
  AND is_test != 1;

source.query:
SELECT
    countrycode  AS cog_countrycode,   -- make this the alternate key and upsert on it
    country      AS cog_name
FROM growecd.countries;

SELECT
    l.centreid AS cog_centreid,
    c.name     AS cog_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cog_learners0to2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cog_learners2to5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 6 AND 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cog_learners6to9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) >= 9            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cog_learners9plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, l.birthdate, CURDATE()) >= 0            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cog_learnerstotal
FROM growecd.learners AS l
LEFT JOIN growecd.centres AS c
       ON c.centreid = l.centreid
WHERE COALESCE(l.archived, 0) <> 1
GROUP BY l.centreid, c.name
ORDER BY l.centreid;

SELECT
    countrycode  AS cog_country,
    region AS cog_name,
regioncode AS cog_regioncode
FROM growecd.regions;
